notes.title: Wings of Prey Update Released
notes.content:
List of changes:

Version 1.0.5.1
* Corrected bugs when the login window may freeze under certain circumstances
* Optimized the login process in the game's launcher
* Optimized the way YUPLAY-client interracts with the launcher
* Improved aircraft textures

notes.title: Wings of Prey Update Released
notes.content:
Updates to Wings of Prey have been released. The updates will be applied automatically when your Steam client is restarted. The major changes include:
New matchmaking system - have to be more effective in connections.
Enhanced FM engine simulation (a few fixes were made, lots of planes will have more realistic FM now)
Optional mission continue in single missions
Optional take off in training
Availability of planes in MP mode is now based on fronts instead of locations
Now it’s possible to slow down and speed up time in replay mode
Some new cameras and other features for replay mode added
Migrating host was fixed
Сonsistency check added to game launcher (don't try it if you have your own skins)
If you have a problem on AMD Athlon(tm) 64 X2 Dual Core, please download an official patch from AMD.
